equity_bridge.item: Associates and joint ventures at book, 37% look-through
equity_bridge.note: FY2025 AR consolidated balance sheet 'Long-term equity investments' RMB2,864m; their RMB287m income is excluded from EBITDA

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: base revenue path average (FY2023-25 organic revenue CAGR 2.7%; H1 FY2026 +0.9%)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (9.2% 5yr) diverges >30% from EPS CAGR (-3.0% 5yr). Equity growth was funded by H-share placements (shares 6,245m -> 7,973m) and retained profit while attributable EPS fell; revenue CAGRs (12%) are inflated by the FY2023 AVIC asset injection (revenue 63.6bn -> 84.7bn). Neither is a forward guide.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF (consolidated FCF - SBC - interest income) was negative in 6 of 8 years (FY2025 -13.1bn, FY2024 -3.6bn, FY2023 -9.9bn), so FCF CAGRs are undefined and set null. Attributable net income FY2021-25: 2.37 -> 2.22 -> 2.45 -> 2.19 -> 1.77bn; H1 FY2026 823m (-20% YoY).

scenario_narratives.base: Defence-anchored mid-single-digit growth: helicopters bottom out after the FY2025/H1 FY2026 volume declines, JONHON's connector business (57% of revenue with ancillary systems) carries growth, and policy support under the 15th Five-Year Plan keeps orders flowing. Margin recovers modestly from the FY2025 low but not to FY2023 levels. The decisive assumption is working capital: receivables stop outgrowing revenue, so the group converts a thin slice of profit into cash for the first time in years.
scenario_narratives.bull: The low-altitude-economy and domestic-airliner narrative becomes revenue: new helicopter and eVTOL certifications convert to orders, Hongdu and Airborne scale into the C919/C929 ramp, JONHON's EV and data-centre connectors grow double digits. Margin recovers to ~11% and PLA payment timing normalises, so working capital consumes 30% of incremental revenue rather than all of the profit.
scenario_narratives.bear: The FY2025 pattern persists: product-mix compression, lapsing VAT/tax benefits and supplementary tax payments, near-zero growth in helicopters, and a customer that pays late. Working capital absorbs 60% of incremental revenue, minorities keep ~63% of what is left, and the AVIC OFAC/1260H designations block any foreign commercial upside.

valuation_philosophy.summary: AviChina is valued as its 37% look-through of a consolidated operating group, on owner FCF, not on its reported earnings. The reported P/E (~12x) and P/B (~0.6x) look cheap, but the group has turned almost none of its profit into cash for eight years -- PLA/AVIC receivables and inventory absorb it -- and ~63% of what it does earn belongs to minority shareholders of JONHON, AVICOPTER and others. The valuation therefore hinges on working-capital conversion, which is modelled explicitly per scenario rather than smoothed away.
key_risks_to_valuation: Working-capital capture is the dominant lever: each 10pp of wc_capture moves value materially; the FY2023-25 record is far worse than even the bear's -60%.
Attributable share (37%) drifts with subsidiary placements and AVIC asset injections; further JONHON/AVICOPTER equity raises would lower it.
AVIC OFAC NS-CMIC and DoD 1260H designations: index exclusion, US-investor access, and escalation risk.
Tax: FY2025 ETR rose to 9.4% on supplementary subsidiary tax; loss of high-tech 15% status or R&D super-deductions lifts the path.
SOTP: market value of listed subsidiary stakes may exceed this DCF; a holdco restructuring or privatisation would be a catalyst the cash-flow model ignores.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 2.775-4.66 HKD
data_sources.financials: 2357.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics) FY2018-FY2025 and H1 FY2026; FY2025 Annual Report consolidated income statement (net profit 4,843 / attributable 1,765 / minority 3,078), cash-flow supplementary note (D&A, working capital), balance sheet and parent-only balance sheet; H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet for cash, borrowings and shares.

inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR consolidated statement of changes in equity, 'Amount of share-based payment recognized as shareholders' equity' RMB19.86m (JONHON Phase III restricted-share plan, net of forfeiture reversal after the third unlock failed). Prior years RMB160-500m; forward path normalised at 0.3% of revenue. No parent-level plan; zero equity-award taxes. Shown here at the 37% look-through.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1724 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-16T22:01Z). Multiply CNY per-share values by 1.1724 to compare with the HKD quote. No A-share or other dual listing exists for a direct parity check; cross-checked against USD/HKD ~7.78 / USD/CNY ~6.64 = 1.172. fx_rate is not refreshed by refresh_price.py.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T08:08:14Z regular close (HKEX), Yahoo Finance chart API
inputs.share_count_basis: 7,972.854m H + domestic shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim); no parent-level options or convertibles, so basic = diluted. Held flat: parent buys back nothing, and the JONHON restricted-share plan dilutes a subsidiary (inside the NCI look-through), not AviChina.
inputs.wacc_rationale: CNY-built, matching the flows: China 10y CGB ~1.8% + beta 1.05 x 6.5% mature ERP + ~1.0% China country premium = ~9.6% cost of equity; group is net cash with ~2.1% borrowing cost, so WACC ~ CoE; 9.5% used in all three scenarios. OFAC NS-CMIC/1260H overhang, SOE governance and working-capital unpredictability are charged in the flows and the 30% bear weight, not stacked on the discount rate.
inputs.nci_treatment: Attributable-only via PROPORTIONATE LOOK-THROUGH at 37%. Parent shareholders received 36.4% of FY2025 consolidated net profit (1,765 of 4,843) and 38.0% in FY2024 (2,187 of 5,754); NCI held RMB64.4bn of RMB99.4bn group equity. base_revenue, every flow line (EBITDA, D&A, capex, working capital) and the net-cash and associate bridge items are all scaled by 0.37, so NCI is charged exactly once and no NCI deduction appears in the bridge. Calibration: consolidated FY2025 EBITDA ex investment income ~RMB8.2bn (9.2%) -> EBIT ~4.9bn -> NOPAT at 9.4% ETR ~4.4bn + after-tax associates/finance ~0.4bn ~= 4.8bn consolidated NPAT; x0.37 = ~1.79bn vs 1.765bn reported attributable. Parent-only balance sheet holds just RMB1.48bn cash and no debt; the look-through share of group net cash (~RMB2.7bn) is used because the subsidiaries' cash is what funds their working capital.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), immaterial: lease liabilities ~RMB0.35bn non-current (FY2025 AR note 35) added to borrowings in net debt; current portion already inside 'non-current liabilities due within one year'. Right-of-use depreciation (RMB124m) sits in D&A; lease cost <0.2% of revenue.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF (component route) with the non-US/cyclical adaptations, on a 37% proportionate look-through of the consolidated group. Routing: AviChina is an operating manufacturing group (helicopters, trainers, avionics/connectors via JONHON, engineering services), not a bank/REIT/LIC; its value is a cash-flow stream, but ~63% of it belongs to minorities in listed subsidiaries, hence the look-through. NO MEMORY ENTRY: first valuation. NORMALISATION: reported consolidated FCF was -RMB12.7bn in FY2025 and the group's cumulative FY2018-25 FCF is ~-RMB19bn (OCF +6.3bn vs capex 25.7bn) while it booked ~RMB35bn of consolidated profit -- receivables and inventory from PLA/AVIC-directed contracts absorb essentially all earnings. The single bad year is NOT smoothed away and NOT carried forward: the component build charges working capital on revenue growth at -40% (base) / -30% (bull) / -60% (bear) of incremental revenue, near the group's net-working-capital intensity, i.e. the model assumes receivables stop outgrowing revenue in the base but does not assume the past build releases. H1 FY2026 OCF +RMB1.8bn (vs -7.2bn in H1 FY2025) is the first sign of that. EBITDA here excludes investment income (associates added in the bridge), interest income (cash in the bridge) and disposal/FV gains, and includes credit and asset impairments (~RMB0.95bn) as recurring costs. SOTP memo, not modelled: the market value of AviChina's stakes in listed JONHON, AVICOPTER, AVIC Airborne and Hongdu is widely cited as exceeding its own market cap (HK holdco discount); that is re-rating optionality, not cash flow to H-share holders, and no number is booked for it. Buybacks: none at the parent (RMB389m FY2025 'payment for stock repurchase' is JONHON restricted shares). Dividends: RMB646m paid to parent shareholders in FY2025.

bear.narrative: Helicopter procurement stays weak, VAT-credit and high-tech tax benefits keep lapsing (subsidiary supplementary tax payments recur), gross margin stays at the FY2025 19.5% low, receivables from PLA/AVIC keep outrunning revenue, and OFAC/1260H escalation caps any commercial or export upside.

base.narrative: Helicopter volumes trough in FY2026, JONHON connectors and avionics grow with defence modernisation, EVs and data centres, 15th FYP support lifts revenue ~5%/yr; EBITDA margin recovers only part of the FY2023 level (11%) to 9.8%; receivables grow in line with revenue rather than ahead of it.

bull.narrative: Low-altitude economy and new platforms (AC332 certified, AC352 SAR, AR-E800 eVTOL) convert into orders, C919/C929 supply ramps, JONHON commercial connectors compound; mix restores the ~11% EBITDA margin of FY2021-23 and PLA payment discipline improves so working capital consumes only 30% of incremental revenue.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30%: the group has not produced positive consolidated FCF in 6 of 8 years, attributable profit has fallen two years running, and cash conversion depends on one customer (PLA/AVIC) paying on time. Base 50%. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things at once -- new-platform orders, margin recovery and working-capital normalisation.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
